brand_notes: See svs-prime-bookshelf notes. Ultra Evolution series: time-aligned sloped cabinets, diamond-coated tweeter; 5-year warranty; >500 dealers (Stereophile spec sidebar). Rated 6 ohm; measured min 3.7 ohm.
takeaways: Stereophile (Tier B): sensitivity 87 dB matches claim; ±3 dB 40 Hz-26 kHz.
Min impedance 3.7 ohm vs 6 ohm rating: effectively-4ohm flag.
THD at 90 dB <0.5% above 100 Hz; directivity broad with 3-7 kHz lobing.
No spinorama/Klippel; LW deviation and pref score not available.
Critics praise bass weight; Stereophile notes limited room-filling bass at low levels without sub.
conflicts: One reseller SKU lists 8 ohm vs maker/Stereophile 6 ohm
Treble described as brighter than LS50 Meta (Stereophile) vs smooth (Audioholics)
